release_notes: Same class of bug as 0.39.2's Dhan fix: Breeze's cross-process rate gate only paced `ltp()`/`quote()` singles — every other endpoint (`historical_data`, `positions`, `holdings`, order calls, the option-chain quote path) called the API with no pacing, sharing ICICI's same account-wide 100/min budget. All Breeze API calls are now gated centrally in `_call()`.
